queries: WITH by_channel AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase) SELECT channel, average_filled_quantity, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM by_channel;

WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, o.orderbase AS channel, SUM(e.fillcount) AS filled_quantity FROM orders o JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.orderbase), by_channel AS (SELECT channel, AVG(filled_quantity) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM per_order GROUP BY channel) SELECT channel, average_filled_quantity, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM by_channel;

SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, SUM(e.fillcount)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(e.fillcount)) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

responses.sql: WITH by_channel AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase) SELECT channel, average_filled_quantity, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM by_channel;

assumptions.assumption: The count and share refer to matched execution records, including records whose fillcount is NULL. AVG ignores NULL fillcount values. A NULL orderbase forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct executed orders instead; sum each order's fills before averaging filled quantity across orders, and calculate shares from order counts.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.orderspivot, o.orderbase AS channel, SUM(e.fillcount) AS filled_quantity FROM orders o JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.orderbase), by_channel AS (SELECT channel, AVG(filled_quantity) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM per_order GROUP BY channel) SELECT channel, average_filled_quantity, order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM by_channel;

responses.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

assumptions.assumption: The count and share refer to matched execution rows; the share uses the total matched execution count.

alternatives.interpretation: Share of total means share of filled quantity across matched executions.
alternatives.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, SUM(e.fillcount)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(e.fillcount)) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

responses.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;

assumptions.assumption: The count and share refer to matched execution rows, including rows with a missing fillcount; AVG ignores those missing values.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct orders with matched executions, and calculate each channel's share of those orders; keep the requested average over execution fillcount values.
alternatives.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase;
